items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Yeah' to the interviewer's mention of Frank Ross. The interviewer states 'I was playing for Bucky... I'd come over Frank and Louis Armstrong was playing,' indicating the interviewer's personal connection, not the interviewee's.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I came up with, after that, Jimmy Noon and Frank Ross. Ross. Sam Ross. Sam Ross. Sam Ross. Sam Ross. Yeah. He was one-eyed. One-eyed. What did he play? Trumpet.
